description: A mid-1940s black and white sepia-toned snapshot depicting a mother kneeling on the sand next to her toddler at a crowded beach. The young boy sits in the sand holding a small container. The photo back includes a developer stamp from The Baldwin Studio in St. Louis, Missouri, printed on Genuine Velox photo paper.
